facebook.caption: POV: you skip the resort pool and end up in a real fishing village. Ham Ninh is what Phu Quoc looked like before the hotels arrived. Weathered wooden piers, boats coming in at dawn, seafood pulled straight from the water. 4.1 stars across 1,048 reviews and still feels nothing like a tourist trap. Take the TL47 road east. Thank yourself later. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
